reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: Section 14(a) selects Delaware law (expressly within the accepted set, at the playbook fallback) with exclusive jurisdiction and venue in state and federal courts in New York, New York — a US court forum in our preferred location, not a foreign venue.

The Section 8 AAA arbitration provision is domestic (AAA Commercial Rules, award enterable in any court of competent jurisdiction) and therefore does not trigger the walk-away position of mandatory arbitration seated abroad; noting the internal inconsistency in the rationale rather than flagging it is consistent with the playbook's treatment of minor sub-elements.
No redline and no counterparty comment were proposed, which is the expected output for a compliant finding; the rendered redline is identical to the original paragraphs.

Deterministic check ('governing law within the accepted set') passes and corroborates the classification; rationale correctly states the clause sits at the fallback rather than the preferred New York law position.
